subject: BYOK / SSO / Audit evidence routing for ClearHealth pilot
messages:
From: Elena Markovic <elena@clearhealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: legal@clearhealth.com
Date: 2028-01-23T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: ClearHealth compliance evidence request — BYOK, retention, SSO

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving the pilot forward and our compliance team needs a short evidence packet to validate Redwood for our regulated environment. High level asks:

- BYOK / KMS: key lifecycle docs, key wrap model (do you allow customer-managed keys across regions?), attestation of no-key-exfiltration from control plane.
- Audit logs: schema, retention options, sample log export (format/csv), availability of per-tenant filtering.
- SSO: SAML metadata, provisioning flow, SCIM behavior (just-in-time vs. provisioning).
- Retention & deletion: proof of retention windows and deletion confirmations (we may need a 7-year retention for certain records).

I attached our evidence questionnaire (clearhealth_evidence_request.pdf). Can Redwood provide a short runbook and sample artifacts within 5 business days for our pilot kickoff? Also looping in our legal mailbox for any contract-level asks.

Best,
Elena
Director of GxP Programs
ClearHealth

Team — forwarding ClearHealth's questionnaire (attached). They want a concise packet for pilot approval. Quick triage: what can we deliver out-of-the-box vs. needs eng/security work?

Immediate asks (please reply in-thread with owners):
- A short BYOK/KMS summary: key wrapping model, cross-region support, rotation and export controls. Owner: ?
- Audit logs: sample export (CSV), explanation of fields, retention options (min/max/default), tenant-level filters. Owner: ?
- SSO/SCIM: SAML metadata file + note on provisioning behavior. Owner: ?
- Retention attestation: can we sign to 7-year retention for the pilot, or do we need a carveout? Who signs operational attestation?

Attachments: clearhealth_evidence_request.pdf (from Elena). Proposed next step: 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on what we can ship in 5 business days and what needs engineering. If not possible, list deliverables and timelines here.

Thanks — Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: elena@clearhealth.com
Date: 2028-01-23T11:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: ClearHealth compliance evidence request — BYOK, retention, SSO

Jasmine / team — thanks for the ping. High-level answers and what we can attach quickly:

1) BYOK / KMS
- We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via envelope encryption. We can provide: key lifecycle doc (exportable PDF), KMS key metadata template, and a short attestation describing that Redwood's control plane does not persist raw customer key material. Cross-region: we support key replication across our EU/US regions for dedicated/private deployments; hosted requires key wrap through our KMS connectors — I'll note constraints.
- Owner: marissa.cole@redwood.com will draft the BYOK summary and example KMS policy.

2) Audit logs
- We can produce an audit export sample in CSV within 24 hours (contains timestamp, principal, action, resource, request_id, result). Retention: hosted default 90 days, dedicated/private configurable up to customer-requested windows; longer retention requires reserved storage and has cost implications.
- Note: for 7-year retention we need an escalated contract + storage commit (ops to confirm feasibility).
- Owner for sample: ben.carter@redwood.com (will attach audit_log_sample.csv).

3) SSO / SCIM
- Provide SAML metadata and SCIM behavior doc. Default provisioning is SCIM-based sync; we can support JIT provisioning for certain customers.
- Owner: grace.oconnor@redwood.com.

4) Retention attestation and contractual language
- We can provide an operational attestation for pilot-level evidence (statements of capability). Formal guarantees for 7-year retention must be negotiated with legal and likely map to Private or Dedicated terms.
- Related link: shared drive folder where we'll drop artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearHealthEvidence

I'll start drafting the BYOK summary and will upload an audit export sample. Ben — please confirm region/volume assumptions for the sample and whether we can support a 7-year hold if customer pays for storage.

– Marissa
Sr. Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: elena@clearhealth.com
Date: 2028-01-24T09:00:00-05:00
Subject: Re: ClearHealth compliance evidence request — BYOK, retention, SSO

Uploading audit_log_sample.csv to the shared drive now. Quick operational notes:

- Sample contains 30 minutes of anonymized entries (timestamp, user.email, action, resource_id, request_id, response_code). Format attached as audit_log_sample.csv.
- Retention: hosted default is 90 days. For 7-year retention we'd need to route exports to long-term object storage (S3/Blob) under a customer-controlled bucket or a RedCloud long-term retention store with quarterly costs estimated. For POC, propose a 2-week export window to demonstrate functionality while commercial terms are worked.
- Cross-region: we can export logs from the region where the tenant is pinned. Replication to another region is possible but adds transfer/ingest time — flagged as a follow-up.

Action items:
- Ben: confirm long-term retention cost estimate + ops runbook (assigned).
- Marissa: BYOK summary draft (assigned).
- Grace: SSO metadata + SCIM behavior doc (assigned).
- Jasmine: coordinate with ClearHealth on which records require 7-year retention (ePHI subset?) and confirm POC timeline.

I attached mutual_action_plan_draft.docx with proposed timelines and who owns each deliverable — please review and redline in-drive.

Thanks,
Ben
Platform Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Markovic <elena@clearhealth.com>

Cc: legal@clearhealth.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Thanks — this looks good. A couple clarifications from our side:

- The 7-year retention is driven by device safety records; we can scope down to a subset of audit events and ePHI-related access logs if that reduces cost.
- For the pilot we agree to the 2-week export window to validate mapping. If everything looks good, we'll sign a short addendum for the long-term export to our bucket (we control the storage).
- Legal will review the mutual_action_plan_draft.docx and provide redlines by EOD Friday.

Can we schedule the 30-min sync tomorrow at 11am ET to walk the sample and BYOK summary? If yes, I will send a calendar invite.

Best,
Elena
